description: The ALTER TABLE action surface with its live-measured refusal shapes: ADD/DROP with comma lists (duplicate 'already exists', missing 'does not exist', also within one statement), RENAME COLUMN speaking in Object terms (taken target spelled table.column), parenthesized and bare column-action lists with COMMENT/UNSET COMMENT, second PRIMARY KEY naming the bare table, property refusals (invalid value / invalid property), CLUSTER BY set and drop, a refused RENAME TO leaving the table untouched, SWAP WITH exchanging whole definitions, a positioned invalid-identifier refusal for ALTER COLUMN on a missing column, SET DEFAULT literal unsupported, and a column comment surviving into DESCRIBE. Converted 1:1 from ddl/AlterTableSurfaceTest (now retired).
